pitcherOqi.method: Leave-one-pitcher-out OPS relative to league (65%) and team (35%); independent PA/(PA+40) shrinkage; BF weighted; 100 is neutral. All pitcher outcomes are excluded from hitter AND reference baselines. No cross-pitcher normalization.

pitcherCpi.name: Contextual Pitching Index
pitcherCpi.method: 65% pitch quality + 25% K−BB% + 10% inverse ERA, sample-regressed and standardized; bounded leave-pitcher-out batter-quality adjustment. Qualified cohort centered at 100. Filth+ is not renamed Stuff+.
